title: The Toll Keeper
text: A bridge of black stone spans nothing. On it squats a hunched keeper with a wooden bowl, its face lost in a hood, naming a price in a voice like grinding millstones. Bones lie far below the bridge in the dark.

options.label: The Leader pays what it asks; the bones below are reason enough.

outcomes.text: The coins ring in the bowl. The keeper steps aside, humming something old.

options.label: The wisest offers it a riddle instead of coin.

outcomes.text: The keeper thinks for a long while, then laughs and lets you pass for the pleasure of it.
It answers at once and asks one back. Nobody knows the answer.

options.label: Shove it off its own bridge to join the bones below.

outcomes.text: It does not go over easily, nor alone.
